summary: Variants can scale specification depth by risk and make the artifact executable, versioned and continuously checked.

items.text: Begin with prompt exploration and promote only resolved assumptions, goals, non-goals and acceptance criteria into the specification.
Compile acceptance clauses into tests, contracts and policy checks that form the executable safety net.
Version specification templates and agent instructions alongside outcome evaluations, just like production prompt text.
Continuously compare implementation, tests and documentation with the active specification and route ambiguous differences for review.
